name: Backblaze64
description: Backblaze Personal Backup running under Wine (64-bit Windows environment) on Ubuntu 24.04. Provides a web-based GUI via browser or VNC. Automatically keeps Backblaze updated to the latest version on each restart.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Persistent storage for the Wine prefix and Backblaze configuration. Must survive container restarts.

paths.name: Backup Source (Drive D)
paths.description: Optional: map a host path to back up as drive D. Must be read-write: Backblaze creates a .bzvol folder in the drive's root to track and back it up. Repeat with /drive_e/, /drive_f/, etc. for additional locations.

ports.name: VNC Port
ports.description: Port for direct VNC client access.

variables.name: User ID
variables.description: UID the app runs as. On Unraid this is normally 99 (nobody), which matches user-share ownership - the app must own the files it backs up, since Backblaze writes a .bzvol folder into each drive's root. Change only if your data is owned by a different user (check with: id -u).

variables.name: Group ID
variables.description: GID the app runs as. On Unraid this is normally 100 (users), matching user-share ownership. Change only if your data is owned by a different group (check with: id -g).

variables.name: Disable Auto-Update
variables.description: Set to true to skip the Backblaze version check on startup (faster boot, but won't auto-update).

variables.name: Disable Virtual Desktop
variables.description: Set to true to disable Wine's virtual desktop mode.
